text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I managed to achieve such great results
by
working consistently and putting
everything I had
into it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This is all because we both worked so
hard,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That said, my opponents delivered a
magnificent
performances as well. If I'd
taken even one wrong
step, the outcome
might have been entirely
different.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it is as you say. Maybe it's the
lingering thrill
of the race that's making
me a little impatient.
choice_data_list: 今は目の前の勝利を喜んでいいよ
さっそく次の準備に入ろう！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
First, let me take a moment to enjoy this
victory
that we achieved together.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then, we can set our sights on the next
race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'd like to reflect on today's race
and ensure I
have a firm grasp of what
occured.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I cannot wait for the next race.
However
tough my next opponents may
be, I'll be sure to
achieve victory.
